data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish name Seán, meaning 'God is gracious'. In the Bible, the name Shannon appears in the book of Joshua, referring to a place near Jericho. The name Shanon carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shanon usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shanon total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The name Shanon has become popular in many English-speaking countries, especially in Ireland and the United States, due to its beautiful sound and the associations with the Irish heritage. In pop culture, notable figures with this name include Shanon Tweed, an actress and model, and Shawn Stockman, a member of Boyz II Men.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shanon embodies the belief in God's unending grace and favor towards us. It is a reminder that no matter the circumstances of life, we are recipients of God's kindness and mercy. A Shanon, thus, is called to live a life that reflects the graciousness of God in all its fullness, showing compassion, kindness, and generosity to others.
